 KUALA LUMPUR: AmBank Group has launched its flood relief assistance programme to customers who are affected by the floods in Selangor, including a moratorium of up to six months on financing 
 Additionally, customers who seek replacement of passbooks, cheque books, fixed deposit certificates, ATM and credit and debit cards will be waived of all incidental and replacement charges, group chief executive officer of AmBank Group Jamie Ling said in a statement today.
 "We are ready to assist our customers as best as we can during this difficult period. Our relief assistance is aimed at alleviating the financial burden of our customers, so that they can focus on recovery and restoring their livelihoods,” he said.
 For application and more information regarding the Flood Relief programme, visit https://www.ambank.com.my/repayment-assistance/flood-relief-programme.
 Meanwhile, customers are advised to use their AmOnline app or website for their banking needs. - Bernama
